audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 are marked Shen while their own explanations say the opposite: whys[1] 'Level 2 stays even' and whys[2] 'Level 3 is skill-decided — a straight Q-for-Q trade with no clear favourite.'
audit.why: The packet chart and the mirror audit both read five even rows then Shen at first item and two-plus items, which fits a 50.82% lane over 1346 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill in both layers; the Shen rows at first item and two-plus items stand.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is named on nearly every line but never numbered, and Stand United's cooldown is never given despite the page calling it 'the whole matchup'.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 and costs 150 energy — after it he cannot immediately Twilight Assault, which is another 140 energy. Stand United is 200s at rank 1. Zaahen's Q and E are both 10s at rank 1, R 110s.
audit.corrected: Write 18s on Shadow Dash and 200s on Stand United, and note the energy cost that follows the taunt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Spirit's Refuge is described as a thing to avoid fighting, but it blocks basic attacks only — abilities land through it. And Stand United is a channel that any displacement cancels; Zaahen's Glaive recast knock-up and his stab-and-pull both do it, and the page never says so. Zaahen's E is also called 'Golden Onslaught' rather than Aureate Rush.
audit.why: Riot's text for W: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' The kit's R carries the channel flag: interruptible, any CC cancels it. Cancelling a 200s ultimate is the single highest-value play available in this lane and it was missing.
audit.corrected: State that abilities pass through Spirit's Refuge, and that knocking Shen up during Stand United cancels a 200s ultimate outright — so shove and stand on him when he starts it.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 — bait the taunt, then commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities — step out and cast.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel — your Glaive recast knock-up or the stab-and-pull cancels it outright.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, 150 energy. Bait it, then commit. - Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities. - Stand United channels: knock him up to cancel it.

edits.before: Shen's Stand United (R) is the whole matchup — the second he hits 6 he can channel a shield onto his jungler bot or mid and teleport in, so track his ult cooldown more than his lane. Your Final Retribution (R) can win the 1v1 but does nothing to stop a cross-map play.
edits.after: Shen's Stand United (R) is the whole matchup — at 6 he can shield an ally across the map and teleport in, so track its 200s rank-1 cooldown more than his lane. It is a channel, though: your Glaive recast knock-up cancels it outright, so shove and stand on him the moment it starts.

edits.before: Shen edges ahead here: with Sunfire/tank item plus his passive Ki Barrier shields he out-sustains your Golden Onslaught (E) all-ins, and his global map pressure via R means he can trade an even lane for two kills elsewhere.
edits.after: Shen edges ahead here: with a tank item plus his Ki Barrier shields he out-sustains your Aureate Rush (E) all-ins — and Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks basic attacks only, so keep trading with abilities inside the bubble instead of backing off.

edits.before: Trading autos into his empty-energy windows

notes: Highest-value find: Stand United carries the channel flag, so Zaahen's Glaive recast knock-up (or the stab-and-pull) cancels a 200s ultimate. Nothing on the page mentioned it. Second: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only — the page treated it as a general no-fight zone. Rows 1 and 2 flipped to Skill because they contradicted their own whys[] text. Zaahen's W and passive still have no verified name anywhere in the data, so both are described by effect.
